TOL-TASK-STORE.name: SQLite task store
TOL-TASK-STORE.algorithm: Use board-scoped parameterized queries, hydrate Task entities canonically, enforce expected revision in update predicates, and translate affected-row counts and SQLite errors into the abstract result algebra.
TOL-TASK-STORE.transaction: Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE for create and complete operations; compare expected revision before mutation and preserve the distinction between not_applied and unknown outcomes.
notes: The composition root supplies a board-specific instance; use cases still enforce trusted actor context.
